foundationTitle: A production-shaped workspace is being assembled
foundationDescription: The shell, routes, local documentation and health boundaries are runnable. Product capabilities remain explicitly planned until their vertical slice is accepted.
plannedSurfaceDescription: This route is reserved by the product blueprint and is not implemented in the Foundation runtime.
localFirstDescription: Loopback ingress and internal runtime networks
helpDescription: The Foundation exposes local public guidance. Permission-aware operator and administrator guidance will arrive with authentication.
helpIndexUnavailable: The local Help index is temporarily unavailable. Open the documentation directly.
notFoundDescription: The requested surface is not registered for this client version.
searchPlanned: Search is planned for a later vertical slice.

system.fixtureDisclosure: Presentation contract fixture only. No backend authorization, session, runtime, or compatibility decision was made.

forbidden.title: This surface is not available
forbidden.description: The requested address is preserved, but this presentation does not reveal whether the resource exists. Return to an allowed location or follow your organization's access-request guidance.

not-found.title: Page not found
not-found.description: This client cannot resolve the requested route. No recent-resource suggestion is shown because no authorized local reference is available.

session-expired.title: Your session has expired
session-expired.description: Protected presentation data was cleared. Sign in again; the server will re-check workspace and resource access before returning.

maintenance.title: Part of Custometry is under maintenance
maintenance.description: Affected operations are temporarily unavailable. Read-only guidance remains available and status refresh is manual and bounded.

upgrade-required.title: A client upgrade is required
upgrade-required.description: Incompatible mutations are blocked. Installation administrators can follow the safe guidance; other users may continue only with explicitly available read-only surfaces.
